title: Rubin and Ford's 1970 Andromeda rotation curve
summary: Their Astrophysical Journal paper maps rotation in Andromeda from emission regions.
body: Vera C. Rubin and W. Kent Ford, Jr., "Rotation of the Andromeda Nebula from a Spectroscopic Survey of Emission Regions" (Astrophysical Journal, 1970), measured how orbital speed in Andromeda changes with radius. Flat outer rotation curves became a major reason astronomers infer extra mass. The paper is one galaxy. It does not identify the mass as a particular particle. CERN's dark-matter page and Milgrom's 1983 alternative are the companion card.
